title: Visa status: respond before midnight
scenario: An email says a change in immigration rules means your student status needs “immediate reconfirmation” before midnight. The form asks for your passport, visa document and current bank balance.

answers.A: Save the message and ask a designated school adviser to review it before submitting anything.
answers.B: Upload the documents now because immigration deadlines can be strict, then confirm tomorrow.
answers.C: Use the immigration authority’s official site and your university international office to verify whether any action is actually required.

explanation: Fear of losing legal status creates extreme urgency. Sensitive immigration documents should move only through verified government/university channels.
proTip: Immigration fear is exactly why the channel must be verified.
